head.t: Award: PHILIPS TECH MAXIMISER CATH LAB / RADIOLOGY IR UPGRADES
head.x: Swansea Bay Health Board. Life-extending Technology Maximiser Plus Allura upgrades for three existing Philips imaging rooms at Morriston Hospital. The upgrades are intended to enable the existing systems to continue in service beyond their forthcoming end-of-life/support position, avoiding full system replacement.

head.t: Philips launches the HyperVue Integrated System, a fixed cath-lab version of its coronary imaging and physiology platform
head.x: Philips announced US commercial availability of the HyperVue Integrated System, a permanently installed, single-room configuration of the HyperVue Imaging System (from its SpectraWAVE acquisition) combining DeepOCT with near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) intravascular imaging and X1-FFR…

head.t: Philips launches new imaging software bringing CT-derived information into live procedures
head.x: Royal Philips has announced the launch of Philips UniGuide 3D Live Guidance—an imaging solution bringing computed tomography (CT)-derived information into its Azurion imaging platform—in Europe and other CE-marked markets.

head.t: Philips wins £80k Cath Lab/radiology upgrade at Morriston Hospital
head.x: Swansea Bay University Health Board has awarded Philips Electronics UK an £80,100 contract for Technology Maximiser Plus Allura upgrades across three existing Philips imaging rooms at Morriston Hospital.
